nodes.title: AGENT GUIDE - MiniMax H3 socket workflow
widgets_values:
AGENT GUIDE - MiniMax H3 two-phase socket workflow

1) INPUT MANAGER (outside the subgraph): choose image/video/audio counts and files. Paired audio selects Video reference 1/2/3; do not upload the same video again for its audio.

2) SUBGRAPH: all VHS_LoadVideoPath loaders, shared FPS, frame cap, resize and per-slot switches are already inside. Do not add a second reference-video path or connect a separate reference_bundle.

3) PROMPT ORDER: use <Picture N>, <Video N>, and <Audio N> in presentation order. Paired audio is numbered by video order, then standalone audio. When Generate audio without reference is ON, remove copy/reference-audio wording; H3 generates a new soundtrack.

4) MODES: one_phase ON bypasses latent upscale and TaoMate and runs PDD 8-Step at final resolution. one_phase OFF runs Phase 1 PDD 8-Step at phase1_scale, then latent upscale and Phase 2 TaoMate 3-Step. Default Phase-2 ManualSigmas: 0.7000, 0.4667, 0.2333, 0.0000.

5) OUTPUT SETTINGS: final_megapixels plus aspect_ratio determine the final canvas, up to 2.0 MP when native_area_cap is OFF. Set FPS and frames to match the source/reference video. Keep the same seed when comparing modes.

6) OUTPUTS: the subgraph exposes Rendered video and Selected audio. Rendered video is connected to SaveVideo (video/minimax_h3, MP4). The audio socket is available for an audio-aware downstream saver.

7) CHECK BEFORE QUEUE: confirm the custom node is loaded, counts match active files, prompt tags match counts, paired-audio sources point to enabled videos with audio, and model/LoRA branches are unchanged during benchmarks.

widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, one continuous medium close-up of a calm woman in her thirties sitting at a small kitchen table in quiet morning light. The static camera holds her face and upper body with natural eye contact, stable framing, realistic skin texture, and precise lip synchronization. She looks toward the camera, takes a small breath, and speaks clearly in a natural conversational voice. The woman with a warm, calm, slightly breathy voice (S1) says: <d>[English] I found the old key in the drawer. If you still want to go, meet me at the station at nine.</d> She finishes the sentence, pauses naturally, gives a small confirming nod, and remains in the same position until the end of the ten-second shot. No cuts, no singing, no other speakers, and no extra people.

overall_soundscape: A quiet indoor room tone continues throughout with soft breathing, subtle clothing movement, and a faint distant household hum. The voice remains clear and close while the room stays calm and unobtrusive.

nodes.title: PHASE 1 - MiniMax H3 + PDD 8-Step
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single woman from <Video 1>. Preserve her exact facial identity from <Video 1> and use the close-up face reference from <Picture 2> to reinforce her facial features, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone, long wavy dark espresso hair, and body proportions. Her replacement outfit is the two-piece dark navy blue triangle bikini from <Picture 1>, with thin halter straps and tie-side bottoms. <Picture 2> is only an identity reference and must never appear as a second person, an overlay, or an object in the scene.
<Subject 2> is the same woman originally shown in <Video 1> wearing the oversized beige high-collar buttoned jacket, ruffled black mini skirt, and tan boots.

summary:
[video editing + face identity reference + outfit replacement + audio reuse] Keep the exact timeline, pose, movement, dance timing, camera work, hallway, door, mirror reflection, lighting, shadows, and framing from <Video 1>. Replace only Subject 2's original clothing with Subject 1's dark navy blue bikini from <Picture 1>, while preserving the same woman's face with the help of <Picture 2>. Do not add another person.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - the facial identity, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, body build, pose, movement, gestures, and screen position from <Video 1> remain consistent throughout. Her clothing is transferred from <Picture 1>. <Picture 2> reinforces identity only and is not visible in the scene.
<Subject 2>: attribute_transfer - her original pose, movement, gestures, dance timing, and screen position are transferred to Subject 1. Her oversized beige jacket, ruffled black mini skirt, and tan boots are completely removed.
<Picture 1>: attribute_transfer - use the visible dark navy blue triangle bikini, thin halter straps, tie-side bottoms, dark color, fabric shape, and construction as the replacement outfit.
<Picture 2>: identity_reference - use the close-up face and hair appearance to stabilize the woman's identity; do not create a second woman or show the reference image.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - <Audio 1> is reused unchanged as the complete final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video remains the same live-action interior hallway scene from <Video 1>. The woman keeps the exact original choreography, body motion, gestures, camera framing, camera movement, timing, mirror reflection, door, furniture, lighting, shadows, and background. Only her clothing changes to the dark navy bikini from <Picture 1>, and her facial identity is reinforced by the close-up reference from <Picture 2>. Maintain natural face consistency, realistic hair motion, correct occlusion, stable hands and limbs, and no extra people, overlays, or visual artifacts.

UNET + text encoder: Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 (or any repack — int8 convrot builds work too). Pair the Ref2VA PDD file with a ref2va UNET, FL2VA with fl2va.

PDD Acc file goes in models/pdd_acc/ — either the original alibaba-pai/MiniMax-H3-Acc-LoRAs release or the pre-converted ComfyUI copy (aptech0081/MiniMax-H3-Acc-LoRAs-ComfyUI). Both load.

Optional: wire reference images into ref_image_0... for identity-locked r2v.

nodes.title: Recipe (do not change)
widgets_values:
PHASE 1 uses the native MiniMax H3 PDD Acc model branch: euler, 8 PDD steps, CFG 1.0, SigmaShift 12/3.

PHASE 2 is intentionally a separate branch from the shifted base model: TaoMate 3-step LoRA, euler, ManualSigmas [0.7000, 0.4667, 0.2333, 0.0000]. The first sigma is the 0.70 denoise setting. The TaoMate LoRA is NOT stacked on the PDD-patched model.

No cache nodes (T8/EasyCache). Character LoRAs can be added only after this baseline is verified.

widgets_values:
VIDEO DIMENSION CONTROLS
WIDTH/HEIGHT feed the selected generation path. PHASE 1 SCALE controls Phase 1 relative to Phase 2 (0.5 = half, 0.8 = 80%). ONE PHASE PDD ON bypasses latent upscale + TaoMate and sends the final target resolution directly through PDD. ONE PHASE PDD OFF keeps the PDD -> latent upscale -> TaoMate two-phase path.
